text: dsh-plugin-learn 是 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的算法学习插件，提供分阶段课程、可筛选的编程练习目录和 Docker 判题工作区。它还支持渐进提示、AI 导师对话、按掌握情况安排的间隔复习，以及从 LeetCode 查找并验证新题目。学习进度和草稿保存在本地；运行练习需要 Docker，导师和查题智能体可使用 DSH 默认模型。

dsh-plugin-learn brings algorithm lessons and coding practice to the DeepSeek Harness Web client. It judges Python and TypeScript work in Docker, offers progressive hints and AI tutoring, schedules reviews, and can find validated LeetCode exercises from a description. Progress is stored locally.

算法课程与理解检查：在 Learn 面板按主题阅读课程、完成练习，并通过检查后继续学习。
编程练习与判题：从题库打开工作区提交 Python 或 TypeScript 代码，由本地 Docker runner 执行并返回判题结果。
渐进式 AI 辅导：练习中逐级索取提示、与导师对话；导师回复会结合题目、草稿和最近判题结果。
按描述添加 LeetCode 题：问题查找器搜索和检查公开题目元数据，再验证题目规格后加入个人题库。
复习与进度记录：系统按到期日期安排复习题，并在提交后更新间隔；面板汇总各主题的掌握情况。
dsh-plugin-learn 运行练习需要 Docker CLI 和可用的 Docker 环境；配置默认使用 Python 与 Node 容器镜像。
问题查找会把关键词、标签和难度筛选提交到配置的 LeetCode GraphQL 服务，用于检索公开题目元数据。

dsh-plugin-learn README · DeepSeek Harness LeetCode：**Learn algorithms inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): lessons, all of LeetCode Hot 100, a sandboxed judge, and an AI tutor.** English | [中文](README.zh.md)

dsh-plugin-learn README · Why：- **All of LeetCode Hot 100**, plus 8 more classics — each with an original summary, three progressive hints, and an explained solution. Statements stay on LeetCode; every problem links to the official page.
- **A real judge on your machine.** Code runs in Docker with no network. Hidden boundary, random, and large cases catch wrong and slow solutions — including design classes, in-place edits, and linked-list/tree node problems.
- **Lessons before problems.** 16 topics, from hashing to dynamic programming, each with a worked example you can trace step by step. Then the tutor writes a short check about the lesson, reviews your answers, and decides when you're ready for the practice problem.
- **Add problems by just describing them.** "3 medium BFS problems I haven't done" — an AI agent finds them on LeetCode, writes the tests, and adds them only if they pass validation.

dsh-plugin-learn README · Quick start：1. **Install Docker Desktop.** Learn then guides the rest: it can start Docker and download the runner images with one click, or run `docker pull python:3.13-alpine node:24-alpine` yourself. 2. **Install the plugin** from `github:kapelame/deepseek-harness-leetcode`: - **Desktop:** Plugins → install from GitHub. - **Web:**

dsh-plugin-learn README · Quick start：```sh
     dsh plugin --profile web add github:kapelame/deepseek-harness-leetcode
     dsh web
     ```

3. **Open Learn** in the sidebar. Explanations default to Chinese; switch to English in Learn → Settings.

dsh-plugin-learn README · Quick start：Needs DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer, below 0.3 (tested on 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.3). A default model (for example, signed in to DeepSeek) is optional: it powers the tutor, tutor-written lesson checks, AI feedback, and Add problems. Running, judging, written hints, and the lessons' built-in check questions work without one.
Install from the command line on Desktop Quit Desktop completely, then run its bundled CLI and reopen Desktop:

dsh-plugin-learn README · Quick start：```sh
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add github:kapelame/deepseek-harness-leetcode
```

The repository ships prebuilt files in `lib/`, so installing runs no build script. Pin a commit for reproducible installs: `github:kapelame/deepseek-harness-leetcode#<commit>`.

dsh-plugin-learn README · How judging works：Every verdict comes from test execution only. Your code runs in a Docker container with no network, a read-only filesystem, and memory, CPU, and process limits; expected answers never enter the container. Each suite combines official example inputs with hidden boundary, random, and large cases, built from a reference solution and checked against an independent brute-force solution. A pass means **"passed local tests"**, not LeetCode acceptance. The optional AI judge adds feedback but can never change the verdict.
dsh-plugin-learn README · Add problems： Practice → **Add problems**. Describe what you want and pick how many (1–5). Progress streams live, and you can stop at any time; problems already added stay.

dsh-plugin-learn README · Add problems：- The agent follows the bundled skill [`skills/learn-problem-author/SKILL.md`](skills/learn-problem-author/SKILL.md), which is visible only to the finder agent, never in your normal Sessions.
- Number, title, difficulty, tags, signature, and examples always come from LeetCode's metadata, never from the model. Paid-only problems and problems that need a judge Learn does not provide are skipped.
- Each problem must pass the same validation as the built-in ones before it is added.
- In our live tests with DeepSeek, a run took 70–300 seconds and added every problem requested.

dsh-plugin-learn README · Privacy：- Your code runs only inside offline Docker containers.
- With a default model, Submit (unless `agents.judge: false`), hints, tutor chat, reflections, and variant generation send the problem summary and your code to that model through DSH. Lesson checks send the lesson and your answers. Add problems sends your description and LeetCode metadata, never your code. Each run appears in your Session history.
- Add problems queries LeetCode's public GraphQL API for problem metadata only: no login, no statements, paced requests with a per-run budget.
- Nothing else leaves your machine, except reminder email if you configure SMTP.

dsh-plugin-learn README · Privacy：
Configuration The plugin adds two rows to your profile: `learn` (the service) and `learn-ui` (the Remote API and UI). Override settings in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. A patch replaces the row's whole `config`, so keep `dataRoot`: ```yaml - id: learn config: dataRoot: !!js dshHomePath('learn') defaultLocale: en Data lives in `learn/` under your DSH home (`~/.dsh` by default); Settings can export it as JSON or reset it.

dsh-plugin-learn README · Privacy：Real email needs `email.transport: smtp`, `email.liveSendingAuthorized: true`, `email.smtp.host`/`port`/`user`, and the SMTP password stored as the DSH credential named by `email.smtp.passwordRef` (default `DSH_LEARN_SMTP_PASSWORD`). Without implicit TLS, STARTTLS is required.
Limitations

dsh-plugin-learn README · Privacy：- Docker is required for running code. DSH's own process sandbox only restricts file writes (it allows network access and reading your files), so Learn does not use it as a substitute.
- Reminders are sent only while DSH is running with the plugin enabled; a missed daily digest is sent later the same day, never on a later day.
- TypeScript submissions have their types removed but are not type-checked.
- The tutor sees only the last ten messages of a conversation.
- While an AI run is active, its Session briefly appears in the sidebar.
- On Desktop, links in reminder emails point to a local port that changes on each launch; use the verification code in the email or set `email.publicBaseUrl`.

dsh-plugin-learn README · Privacy：
Build from source `source/` holds three DSH workspace packages built with the DSH toolchain: ```sh git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git dsh git -C dsh checkout dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2 node scripts/build.mjs ./dsh # copy sources in, install, build, assemble lib/ ``` Use `--skip-install` to rebuild an installed checkout. Run tests inside the checkout with `npx vitest run packages/experimental/learn/tests` (needs Docker).

dsh-plugin-learn README · Privacy：Content lives in `content/` (`content/collections/hot-100.yaml` lists the Hot 100 groups). Each problem has YAML metadata with input domains, a reference solution, an independent brute-force oracle, optional hooks, and a frozen, validated test suite. `authoring/` holds the scripts that generate the Hot 100 content and freeze its suites.
